items.title_en: Distinct Hippocampal Cellular Pathologies Influence Cognition Across Diagnostic Categories and Distinguish Schizophrenia from Affective Psychosis
items.title_zh: 不同的海马细胞病理学影响不同诊断类别中的认知，并区分精神分裂症与情感性精神病
items.abstract_en: Cognitive deficits are core features of psychosis and strong predictors of functional outcome, but are largely refractory to pharmacological treatments. It remains unresolved whether these deficits share cellular mechanisms across the psychosis spectrum (as in transdiagnostic models) or differ across DSM-5 diagnostic boundaries, particularly those separating schizophrenia from affective psychoses. We tested this by examining associations between MATRICS Cognitive Battery scores and whole-hippocampal proton magnetic resonance spectroscopic imaging (1H-MRSI) neurometabolite biomarkers of cellular pathologies in 33 participants with psychosis (20 schizophrenia, 13 affective psychosis), 22 with non-psychotic affective disorders, and 25 healthy controls. Metabolite biomarkers included N-acetylaspartate (NAA) for neuronal integrity; myo-inositol (mI) for glia; choline (Cho) for membrane/myelin turnover; and glutamate+glutamine (Glx) for glutamatergic neurotransmission. Metabolite concentrations did not differ between groups but showed group-specific associations with cognition. In healthy controls, lower NAA was associated with poorer overall cognition, working memory, and reasoning (rs=.41, .42, and .43, respectively; p's<.05). Among non-psychotic affective cases, lower mI and higher Cho were associated with worse verbal learning (rs=.50 and -.45, respectively; p's<.05). In psychosis, lower Cho predicted poorer visual learning (rs=.51; p=.002). The clearest between-group divergence involved social cognition, the cognitive domain most predictive of functioning in psychosis: worse performance was associated with lower Glx in schizophrenia (rs=.67; p=.033) but higher Cho and NAA in affective psychosis (rs=-.58 and -.58, respectively; p's<.05). Each metabolite-social cognition association was opposite in direction and differed significantly between these groups (p's<.05), contrary to what transdiagnostic models would predict. These findings suggest distinct hippocampal cellular substrates of social cognitive impairments in schizophrenia and affective psychosis, supporting diagnosis-specific treatment targets and warranting replication in larger samples.
items.abstract_zh: 认知缺陷是精神病的核心特征，也是功能结局的强预测因子，但在很大程度上对药物治疗无效。这些缺陷在整个精神病谱系中是否共享细胞机制（如跨诊断模型所认为），还是在 DSM-5 诊断边界之间不同，尤其是区分精神分裂症与情感性精神病的边界，仍未解决。我们通过检查 33 名精神病参与者（20 名精神分裂症，13 名情感性精神病）、22 名非精神病性情感障碍患者和 25 名健康对照者的 MATRICS 认知成套测验得分与全海马质子磁共振波谱成像（1H-MRSI）细胞病理学神经代谢物生物标志物之间的关联来检验这一点。代谢物生物标志物包括用于神经元完整性的 N-乙酰天冬氨酸（NAA）、用于胶质细胞的肌醇（mI）、用于膜/髓鞘周转的胆碱（Cho）以及用于谷氨酸能神经传递的谷氨酸+谷氨酰胺（Glx）。代谢物浓度在各组之间没有差异，但显示出与认知的组特异性关联。在健康对照中，较低的 NAA 与较差的总体认知、工作记忆和推理相关（rs 分别为 .41、.42 和 .43；p 值均<.05）。在非精神病性情感障碍病例中，较低的 mI 和较高的 Cho 与较差的言语学习相关（rs 分别为 .50 和 -.45；p 值均<.05）。在精神病中，较低的 Cho 预测较差的视觉学习（rs=.51；p=.002）。最明显的组间差异涉及社会认知，这是精神病中最能预测功能的认知域：较差的表现与精神分裂症中较低的 Glx 相关（rs=.67；p=.033），但在情感性精神病中与较高的 Cho 和 NAA 相关（rs 分别为 -.58 和 -.58；p 值均<.05）。每个代谢物-社会认知关联在这些组之间方向相反且差异显著（p 值均<.05），这与跨诊断模型的预测相反。这些发现表明，精神分裂症和情感性精神病中社会认知损伤具有不同的海马细胞底物，支持诊断特异性治疗靶点，并需要在更大样本中重复验证。

items.title_en: PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration
items.title_zh: PISim：用于硬件感知跨层设计空间探索的统一光子推理模拟器
items.abstract_en: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensity noise (RIN), thermal drift, propagation loss, and channel crosstalk---alongside an analytical cycle-level interface timing model to expose electronic-optical bottlenecks. Using simulated MNIST multilayer perceptron (MLP) benchmarks, we demonstrate how PISim identifies optimal precision operating points under multi-impairment stress (peaking at 6 bits for Mach--Zehnder and microring modulators), quantifies a 52.5 percentage-point accuracy gap between VCSEL-array and parallel-fanout laser architectures arising, under the modeled conditions, from power partitioning and correlated source noise, and models interface-limited throughput scaling across emitter-array widths from 32 to 128 channels. This comprehensive framework establishes an extensible, reproducible foundation for accuracy-constrained Pareto optimization prior to photonic tape-out.
items.abstract_zh: 光子神经加速器提供超低延迟的线性代数，但其可用数值精度、可持续吞吐量和应用精度仍受周围电光接口和物理非理想性的严格限制。流片前设计空间探索（DSE）需要跨层电子设计自动化（EDA）框架，能够在相同神经工作负载和物理假设下评估不同的光学拓扑。我们提出 PISim，一个统一光子推理模拟器，将预训练深度神经网络执行与六类加速器架构、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织和直接或相干读出方案的基于物理的模型耦合起来。PISim 嵌入阶段分辨的损伤算子——涵盖控制与模数量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相关相对强度噪声（RIN）、热漂移、传播损耗和通道串扰——以及一个解析的周期级接口时序模型，以揭示电光瓶颈。使用模拟的 MNIST 多层感知机（MLP）基准，我们展示 PISim 如何识别多损伤压力下的最佳精度工作点（Mach–Zehnder 和微环调制器峰值均为 6 位），量化 VCSEL 阵列与并行扇出激光架构之间 52.5 个百分点的精度差距——在建模条件下该差距源于功率分配和相关光源噪声——并建模从 32 到 128 通道的发射器阵列宽度上受接口限制的吞吐量扩展。这一综合框架为光子流片前精度约束的帕累托优化建立了可扩展、可复现的基础。

items.title_en: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
items.title_zh: Pyrite：构建并基准测试蛋白质-配体位姿排序智能体
items.abstract_en: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.
items.abstract_zh: 预测配体如何与其靶标结合是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠模型可以生成多样的候选位姿，但可靠地对这些候选进行排序仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 Pyrite，一个成对位姿排序基准，包含跨多样蛋白质-配体复合物的 1,500 个位姿对。配备 3D 可视化工具和基于物理评分的专家化学家表现接近随机，凸显了解释可用化学信号的难度。为了研究自动排序，我们提出 PyriteRep，一种分子几何、蛋白质-配体相互作用和物理化学评分的结构化表示，并开发了两个基于 LLM 的智能体：PyriteReasoner，通过基于文本的推理直接比较位姿；以及 PyriteFeaturizer，生成可执行代码以构建用于逻辑回归的特征，并可选地纳入由 LLM 子调用导出的特征。这些智能体分别达到最高 67% 和 74% 的准确率，超过观察到的专家表现。LLM 引导的特征发现通常优于直接推理，而 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）改进了开放权重模型，使其在我们的评估中能够匹配或超过闭源前沿模型。这些结果确立了 Pyrite 作为位姿排序能力的具有挑战性的测试，并突出 LLM 引导的特征发现是解释和组合计算化学工具输出的一种有前景的方法。

items.title_en: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
items.title_zh: 预训练数据统计量塑造语言模型中实体比较学习的阶段
items.abstract_en: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
items.abstract_zh: 数据如何在预训练全程塑造语言模型（LM）行为？我们通过实体比较的案例研究来研究这个问题，例如，“在法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”，涵盖五种实体类型的九个比较任务。我们首先进行受控实验，在来自预训练语料的自然文本和合成任务数据的混合上训练小型 LM（1.63 亿参数）。我们的分析识别出三个不同的学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，LM 按频率选择实体；（2）中期阶段，LM 按提示中的位置选择实体（第一个 vs. 最后提到的实体）；（3）后期阶段，LM 选择作为正确答案的实体。我们表明，这三个阶段的出现由训练数据的统计特性因果决定。使用少量任务特定合成数据时，我们只观察到前两个阶段，模型未能学会该任务；使用大量数据时，模型直接从基于频率的启发式跳到正确解决任务。此外，将实体频率分布从自然出现的齐普夫分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数实体罕见）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加速任务学习。最后，我们表明，来自受控实验的三个训练动态阶段出现在开源模型 OLMo-2 32B 中。总之，我们的发现表明预训练数据的特性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并表明小规模合成实验可以预测更大规模的训练动态。

items.title_en: Reins: Frontier Multimodal Models Driving Real Robot Arms on Long-Horizon Tasks, Zero-Shot
items.title_zh: Reins：前沿多模态模型零样本驱动真实机械臂执行长时程任务
items.abstract_en: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5 等前沿模型现在可以规划并调用工具，但在驱动机器人完成长时程、接触丰富的操作时仍表现困难，且在机械臂移动和模型思考期间处于盲态。我们提出 Reins，一个框架，其中现成模型借助 3D 感知工具和可报告接触与抓握的原子动作操作双臂机器人。模型在一次调用中串联动作，每个动作都有一个必须成立的条件，并在第一个失败处停止；第二个实例——叙述者——持续观看摄像头，并报告每个结果带来的变化。Reins 还从图像构建可仿真的场景孪生，用于持续策略学习。在自然语言提示且无任务特定代码的情况下，GPT-6.1 Sol 在五项任务的真实回合中成功率为 88%；没有该框架时，它在每个 shell game 中都失败，且耗时增加 8 倍。三个前沿模型表现相近，但在跟踪执行者思考期间发生变化的场景方面存在差异。代码将在发表时发布。

items.title_en: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
items.title_zh: 第八届LSVOS挑战赛报告：移动统一多模态理解
items.abstract_en: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告总结了与ECCV 2026同期举办的第八届大规模视频目标分割（LSVOS）挑战赛中的移动统一多模态理解（MUMU）赛道。MUMU要求使用一个统一的单一模型，在0.5B参数和8 GB峰值推理内存的预算内，联合执行面向质量、场景和事件词表的多概念图像标注、开放词汇目标检测以及简洁图像描述。提交结果按由效率因子缩放的加权任务得分进行排名。我们描述了任务、规则和评估协议，报告最终结果，并回顾前三名团队的方法。所有三个领先方案都基于紧凑的Florence-2-base模型，但以不同方式对其扩展：带跨任务推理细化的轻量级标注头；在覆盖感知的多源数据上训练并采用任务相关解码的共享低秩适配器；以及将描述映射为标签并应用检测测试时增强的无需训练流水线。结果表明，当为每个任务设计监督、解码和跨任务线索时，一个紧凑的基于提示的视觉语言模型可以服务于所有三种输出，而新类别上的开放词汇检测仍是主要瓶颈。

items.title_en: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: 面向生物学家的AI：智能体系统时代基础模型的知识边界
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations. Agentic systems, AI assistants built on large language models, can run multistep analyses from plain-language requests and increasingly call foundation models as tools. Yet it is often unclear when these models' outputs can be trusted. We frame this as a model's knowledge boundary: the range of inputs, tasks, and conditions over which its outputs are reliable. This review explains how foundation models are built and proposes that five design elements (data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis) define this boundary. We examine evidence on where current models succeed or fail and present standardized descriptions of model limits so that researchers, and the agents acting for them, can use these tools reliably.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变生物学研究的方式。基于数百万核苷酸、蛋白质和单细胞测量数据训练的生物学基础模型可预测蛋白质结构、突变效应以及细胞对遗传扰动的响应。智能体系统，即构建于大语言模型之上的AI助手，能够根据自然语言请求运行多步骤分析，并越来越多地将基础模型作为工具调用。然而，这些模型的输出何时可信往往并不清楚。我们将其界定为模型的知识边界：其输出可靠的输入、任务和条件范围。本综述解释了基础模型如何构建，并提出五个设计要素（数据、架构、训练方案、评估方案和后分析）界定了这一边界。我们考察了当前模型在何处成功或失败的证据，并提出模型局限的标准化描述，以便研究人员及其代理智能体能够可靠地使用这些工具。

items.title_en: Design and optimization of multilevel zone plates for flying focus applications
items.title_zh: 用于飞焦点应用的多级波带片设计与优化
items.abstract_en: Flying focus pulses, characterized by programmable velocities decoupled from the group velocity, offer remarkable potential for high-intensity laser-matter interactions. However, achieving low-cost manufacturing while simultaneously suppressing higher-order foci and maintaining high efficiency remains a key challenge. Here, we propose a modulated width zone plate with $2^{M}$ steps (MWZP-$2^{M}$S). By employing Monte Carlo sampling of sinusoidal random widths, the MWZP-8S design statistically mimics a Gabor zone plate, suppressing higher-order foci by four orders of magnitude. Furthermore, the multilevel phase modulation converts opaque regions into constructive phase-shifting zones, significantly boosting the focusing efficiency to 73.7$\%$ when $M=3$. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the focal velocity is flexibly tunable across subluminal and superluminal regimes while remaining stable over 100 Rayleigh lengths. This scalable and cost-effective scheme provides a robust platform for flying focus applications in EUV generation and X-ray optics.
items.abstract_zh: 飞焦点脉冲具有与群速度解耦的可编程速度，为高强度激光-物质相互作用提供了显著潜力。然而，在实现低成本制造的同时抑制高阶焦点并保持高效率仍是一项关键挑战。在此，我们提出一种具有$2^{M}$台阶的调制宽度波带片（MWZP-$2^{M}$S）。通过采用正弦随机宽度的蒙特卡洛采样，MWZP-8S设计在统计上模拟Gabor波带片，将高阶焦点抑制四个数量级。此外，多级相位调制将不透明区域转换为相长移相区，当$M=3$时将聚焦效率显著提升至73.7$\%$。数值模拟表明，焦点速度可在亚光速和超光速范围内灵活调谐，同时在100个瑞利长度上保持稳定。这种可扩展且成本有效的方案为极紫外（EUV）产生和X射线光学中的飞焦点应用提供了稳健平台。

items.title_en: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
items.title_zh: 使用能量像素方法估计训练高分辨率结合模型所需的第二代DEL规模
items.abstract_en: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.
items.abstract_zh: DNA编码库（DEL）通常用于寻找靶标蛋白的小分子结合物。但难点已不再是找到一个命中物，而是构建一个足够好的机器学习模型来指导后续的药物化学工作，该模型能够分辨化学家改变单个原子时的亲和力变化。这样的模型需要其训练数据具备两点：对命中物周围小片化学空间的密集采样，以及其中足够数量的真正紧密结合物。多样化的朴素DEL两者都不能提供。它采样巨大的空间，因此任何单一邻域的覆盖都过于稀疏，而最紧密的结合物很罕见。在该朴素DEL数据上训练的模型必须外推到比其所见任何结合物都更紧密的结合物，而这正是模型可能失败之处。获得同时具备这两种性质的训练数据的一种方法是围绕命中物构建第二代DEL。我们探讨该库必须有多复杂。我们将结合视为小型独立相互作用之和，称为靶标上的像素和配体上的反像素。根据在朴素库中测得的亲和力分布，在无结构信息且尚未合成任何物质的情况下，我们估计这样的库必须具有的复杂度，以提供那种密集采样和那些紧密结合物。该方法做了两件有用的事。它将模型所需的紧密结合物数量转化为库必须包含的化合物数量。并且它估计随机设计的第二代DEL的预期产率，从而可以将使用机器学习或主动学习设计该库所带来的增益与基线进行比较，而无需承担与实验本身同样大的对照库费用。

items.title_en: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习后印度语任务的提升与回退
items.abstract_en: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
items.abstract_zh: 我们从覆盖英语和八种印度语言的、经监督微调的30B-A3B专家混合模型出发，在四个环境中使用GRPO运行强化学习（RL）。我们在一次评估活动中比较RL前后模型在34个基准上的表现。MATH提升36.07分，大多数印度语基准也有提升。然而，随着英语回答从8.7%升至91.7%，XQuAD-Indic F1下降19.32分；IndicQA下降8.64，而英语XQuAD提升11.71 F1。从相同监督初始化开始的第二次RL运行增加了一个印度语环境以及语言奖励和重复奖励。与已发布模型相比，它在段落问答和指令遵循基准上均有提升，同时保持MATH性能。但在推理和编码基准上有所退步。若干训练选择同时改变，因此我们无法分离任一奖励项的影响。文字系统合规性仍未解决。添加语言奖励并未确保使用所要求的文字系统。因此，即使其他基准分数提升，段落问答和文字系统合规性也需要直接评估。

items.title_en: Adapting Monocular Depth Estimation in Novel Scenes through Disparity Refinement and Robot Ego-Motion
items.title_zh: 通过视差细化与机器人自运动在新场景中适配单目深度估计
items.abstract_en: The geometric understanding of a scene is a crucial component for safe and efficient robotic operations in novel and unstructured environments. The recent emergence of foundation models for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has provided an opportunity to enrich robotic perception capabilities with dense long-range depth predictions, replacing expensive onboard hardware (e.g., LiDARs and stereo cameras). However, these offline models are primarily trained on affine-invariant depth representations, and their generalization to novel scenes remains unclear. In this work we present EM-ViT, a monocular depth estimation model that learns to adapt online relative depth inputs from a foundation model prior to the metric scale with observations collected during robotic operations. Motivated by the stereo camera parameterization, our method decomposes depth prediction via dense disparity refinement to recover the scene's relative structure and an effective baseline scalar prediction to determine the missing metric scale. The learning process leverages sparse LiDAR points and, optionally, the robot's Ego-Motion (EM) to rapidly train a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT), while an internal gradient matching loss preserves the fine-grained semantic structure of the input disparity in real-time. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on publicly available sequences, such as KITTI, and show that our online learning pipeline can adapt to novel scenes faster and with higher accuracy than existing MDE foundation models. The code and supplementary materials will be publicly available at https://emvit-mde.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 对新奇、非结构化场景的几何理解是机器人安全高效作业的关键。单目深度估计（MDE）基础模型的出现，使机器人有机会用稠密长程深度预测增强感知能力，从而替代昂贵的车载硬件（如 LiDAR 与立体相机）。然而这些离线模型主要基于仿射不变深度表示训练，其在新场景中的泛化性仍不清楚。本文提出 EM-ViT，一个单目深度估计模型，它能够利用机器人运行期间采集的观测，在线把基础模型先验给出的相对深度自适应到米制尺度。受立体相机参数化的启发，该方法将深度预测分解为稠密视差细化（用于恢复场景相对结构）与一个有效基线标量预测（用于确定缺失的米制尺度）。学习过程利用稀疏 LiDAR 点，并可选地利用机器人自运动（EM），快速训练一个轻量 Vision Transformer（ViT）；同时一个内部梯度匹配损失实时保持输入视差的细粒度语义结构。我们在 KITTI 等公开序列上验证了方法有效性，表明该在线学习流程比现有 MDE 基础模型适应新场景更快、精度更高。
items.highlight_zh: 用视差细化加自运动在线学习，把仿射深度快速对齐到米制尺度
items.digest_zh: 机器人要在陌生、杂乱的场景里安全行动，就必须知道“东西离我多远”。近年出现的单目深度估计（MDE）基础模型可以只靠一张图像给出稠密、长距离的深度图，理论上能替代 LiDAR 或立体相机这类昂贵硬件。但问题是：这些模型大多在“仿射不变深度”表示上训练，即输出的深度只保证相对顺序正确，缺少真实的米制尺度，且它们在新场景中是否可靠并不清楚。作者提出 EM-ViT：不重新训练大模型，而是在机器人实际运行中做在线适配。方法借鉴立体相机的参数化思路，把深度预测拆成两部分——一是对基础模型给出的相对深度（视差）做稠密细化，恢复场景的相对几何结构；二是预测一个“有效基线”标量，用来补上缺失的米制尺度。训练信号来自机器人上稀疏的 LiDAR 点，另外还可以选地利用机器人自运动（Ego-Motion）信息；需要学的只是一个轻量级 Vision Transformer，因此能快速收敛。为避免细化过程破坏原有细节，作者设计了一个内部梯度匹配损失，在实时训练中保留输入视差中的细粒度语义结构。在 KITTI 等公开序列上的实验表明，这套在线学习流程比现有 MDE 基础模型适应新场景更快、精度更高。意义在于：机器人可以在部署后利用自身传感器实时“校准”通用深度模型，而不必依赖昂贵硬件或离线重训。

items.title_en: DuoJEPA: Cross-Modal Translation Between Unaligned Self-Supervised Embedding Spaces
items.title_zh: DuoJEPA：未对齐自监督嵌入空间之间的跨模态翻译
items.abstract_en: Learning from paired modalities is commonly equated with aligning them: two encoders are trained until the embeddings of a pair coincide in a shared space. We study whether cross-modal retrieval and classification can instead be obtained while the two encoders' own embedding spaces remain directly unaligned. DuoJEPA trains one encoder per modality with the self-supervised LeJEPA objective and appends to each encoder a single transformer layer that translates its embedding into the other encoder's space, supervised by a contrastive objective computed entirely within that target space. No loss term compares the two own spaces directly, although the encoders are optimised jointly through the translation objective. In our experiments, the translator's residual connections determine where the cross-modal pressure is absorbed: with a residual translator the two encoders become directly aligned, whereas with a skipless (residual-free) translator a paired-cosine test detects no alignment in the final models, and at most a weak one in the ablations, at comparable cross-modal performance. The learned class-token translation is well approximated by a single scaled rotation of the source space. We evaluate DuoJEPA on two modality pairs that differ in nearly every respect. On chest radiographs and reports from CheXpert Plus, it attains a zero-shot AUC of 86.6 and a cross-modal retrieval score of 78.5, compared with 60.0 and 64.2 for our reimplementation of LeVLJEPA with the same encoders and data. On Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar imagery, the frozen encoders fall within the range of published Sentinel foundation models under our reproduction of the Copernicus-Bench linear-probe protocol, the translator retrieves the paired image of the other sensor among 4,000 candidates in 77-79% of cases, and a patch-level extension transfers the within-image similarity structure of the scene.
items.abstract_zh: 从配对模态中学习通常被等同于对齐它们：训练两个编码器，直至一对样本的嵌入在共享空间中重合。我们研究的是：在两个编码器各自的嵌入空间保持直接不对齐的情况下，是否仍能获得跨模态检索与分类。DuoJEPA 以自监督 LeJEPA 目标为每个模态训练一个编码器，并在每个编码器后附加一个 transformer 层，将其嵌入翻译到另一个编码器的空间，其监督信号是完全在该目标空间内计算的对比目标。尽管两个编码器通过翻译目标进行联合优化，但没有任何损失项直接比较两个自身空间。在我们的实验中，翻译器的残差连接决定了跨模态压力被吸收的位置：使用带残差的翻译器时，两个编码器变为直接对齐；而使用无跳连（无残差）翻译器时，配对余弦检验在最终模型中检测不到对齐，在消融实验中至多检测到弱对齐，而跨模态性能相当。学习到的类别 token 翻译可被源空间的一个单一缩放旋转很好地近似。我们在两个几乎各方面都不同的模态对上评估 DuoJEPA。在 CheXpert Plus 的胸部 X 光片与报告上，它取得 86.6 的零样本 AUC 和 78.5 的跨模态检索分数，而我们使用相同编码器与数据重新实现的 LeVLJEPA 为 60.0 和 64.2。在 Sentinel-2 光学与 Sentinel-1 雷达影像上，在我们复现的 Copernicus-Bench 线性探测协议下，冻结编码器落在已发表 Sentinel 基础模型的范围内，翻译器在 4,000 个候选中以 77-79% 的情况检索到另一传感器的配对影像，且一个 patch 级扩展迁移了场景的图像内相似性结构。

items.title_en: Protein Language Models Fail To Capture Contact Predictions Under Invariant Relabeling
items.title_zh: 蛋白质语言模型在不变重标号下无法捕捉接触预测
items.abstract_en: Protein language models (pLMs) produce highly accurate contact maps from single-sequence inputs. People often take this accuracy as proof that these models implicitly learn invariant coevolutionary statistics, extracting the same signals as classical alignment-based methods like Potts. In this work, we introduce a diagnostic framework around a global bijective relabeling of the amino-acid alphabet. This transformation permutes residue letters while leaving all alignment-level information, column entropies, and pairwise edit distances unchanged. Pseudolikelihood Potts models and inverse-covariance estimators remain invariant under this transformation, but pLMs fail the test. Across multiple architectures (ESM-2, MSA Transformer, AMPLIFY) and model scales (8M to 3B parameters), pLM contact maps collapse under arbitrary relabeling. Using Hamming distance controls and biochemical grouping interventions, we attempt to isolate what likely causes this degradation and find that these models rely on explicit, canonical residue identities (``alphabet anchoring'') rather than pure coevolutionary statistics. Increasing scale makes models more responsive to biochemical classes, but their performance still degrades under relabeling. Our findings show a gap between how pLMs and classical coevolutionary models compute contacts. More broadly, our work shows how diagnostic perturbations that leave classical models provably unchanged can expose hidden representation biases and prevent over-reliance on neural black boxes in biological modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型（pLM）可从单序列输入生成高度准确的接触图。人们常将这种准确性视为这些模型隐式学习不变协同进化统计、提取与 Potts 等经典基于比对的方法相同信号的证明。在本工作中，我们围绕氨基酸字母表的全局双射重标号引入一个诊断框架。该变换置换残基字母，同时保持所有比对层级信息、列熵与成对编辑距离不变。伪似然 Potts 模型与逆协方差估计器在该变换下保持不变，但 pLM 未通过该检验。在多种架构（ESM-2、MSA Transformer、AMPLIFY）和模型规模（8M 至 3B 参数）上，pLM 接触图在任意重标号下崩溃。使用汉明距离对照与生化分组干预，我们尝试分离可能造成这种退化的原因，发现这些模型依赖显式的规范残基身份（“字母表锚定”），而非纯协同进化统计。增大规模使模型对生化类别更敏感，但其性能在重标号下仍然退化。我们的发现表明 pLM 与经典协同进化模型在计算接触的方式上存在差距。更广泛地说，我们的工作展示了使经典模型可证明保持不变的诊断性扰动如何能够揭示隐藏的表示偏差，并防止在生物建模中过度依赖神经黑箱。

items.title_en: An optical-frequency-comb-enabled unified infrastructure for quantum networks
items.title_zh: 一种由光学频率梳赋能的量子网络统一基础设施
items.abstract_en: Quantum networks require precision timing and classical communication to coordinate distributed quantum operations, yet these functions are typically supported by separate infrastructures, increasing system complexity and limiting scalability. Here we demonstrate an optical-frequency-comb-enabled infrastructure that unifies precision timing, classical communication and quantum communication over a shared fibre link. By encoding classical data onto the intensity of the comb while retaining its pulse timing, we simultaneously transmit data at 100 Mbit/s and achieve a timing stability of 0.85 fs at 1 s over 100 km. We develop a spectral-engineering strategy to suppress the coupling between data modulation and timing extraction. We further establish a power-dependent model of the excess noise induced in a co-propagating continuous-variable quantum key distribution channel, identifying optical power, wavelength allocation and propagation direction as the principal control parameters. After optimization, the system introduces only 0.0037 shot noise unit of additional excess noise and limits the secret-key-rate penalty to 6.7%. Furthermore, quantum-secured timestamp transmission additionally enables absolute time synchronization with a stability of 0.26 fs at 1 s. These results establish optical frequency combs as a common physical layer for integrated quantum-network services.
items.abstract_zh: 量子网络需要精密定时与经典通信来协调分布式量子操作，然而这些功能通常由彼此独立的基础设施支持，增加了系统复杂度并限制了可扩展性。在此，我们展示一种由光学频率梳赋能的基础设施，在共享光纤链路上统一精密定时、经典通信与量子通信。通过将经典数据编码到频率梳的强度上而保留其脉冲定时，我们在 100 km 上同时以 100 Mbit/s 传输数据并实现 1 s 处 0.85 fs 的定时稳定度。我们开发了一种光谱工程策略，以抑制数据调制与定时提取之间的耦合。我们进一步建立了同向传输连续变量量子密钥分发信道中所引入额外噪声的功率依赖模型，确定光功率、波长分配与传播方向为主要控制参数。经过优化，系统仅引入 0.0037 散粒噪声单位的额外过量噪声，并将密钥率损失限制在 6.7%。此外，量子安全时间戳传输还实现了 1 s 处稳定度 0.26 fs 的绝对时间同步。这些结果确立了光学频率梳作为集成量子网络服务的公共物理层。

items.title_en: A Recipe for Physical Action Model Training
items.title_zh: 物理动作模型训练的一种配方
items.abstract_en: Choosing robot model capacity and demonstration budgets also requires decisions about data composition, representation, optimization, and deployment. We connect these decisions through a common conditional-distribution target. Nested learning oracles give exact risk accounting; local information geometry, conditional mutual information, and empirical convergence provide conditional training prescriptions. Known-target numerical checks expose capacity-data coupling, representation-induced mixture mismatch, and an example where deployment KL increases while negative log-likelihood decreases. An analysis of 206 public PushT trajectories evaluates fixed-feature information-design criteria without fitting a policy. Under asymmetric evaluation targets, the selected allocations reduce this criterion by 4.5-6.2% relative to target matching; balanced targets show no benefit. These results clarify which quantities can support training recommendations and when an apparently favorable predictive metric has a different interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 选择机器人模型容量与示教预算，还需要就数据组成、表示、优化与部署做出决策。我们通过一个共同的条件分布目标将这些决策联系起来。嵌套学习预言机给出精确的风险核算；局部信息几何、条件互信息与经验收敛性提供条件化训练处方。已知目标的数值检验揭示了容量-数据耦合、表示诱导的混合不匹配，以及一个部署 KL 增加而负对数似然下降的例子。对 206 条公开 PushT 轨迹的分析在不拟合策略的情况下评估固定特征的信息设计准则。在非对称评估目标下，所选分配相对于目标匹配将该准则降低 4.5-6.2%；平衡目标未显示收益。这些结果阐明了哪些量可以支持训练建议，以及一个看似有利的预测指标何时具有不同的解释。

items.title_en: A Time-Frequency-Condition Multimodal Fusion Foundation Model for Universal Rotating-Machinery Fault Diagnosis under Multi-Element Heterogeneous Scenarios
items.title_zh: 一种用于多要素异构场景下通用旋转机械故障诊断的时-频-条件多模态融合基础模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis models are typically developed for a single machine under a specific set of operating conditions, such that each new machine or condition requires retraining from scratch. This one-machine-one-model paradigm scales poorly. Although transfer learning and domain generalization can reduce the labeling burden, they primarily seek domain-invariant commonality, potentially discarding machine-specific characteristics that are critical for diagnosis. This paper proposes TFC-MMFD, a time-frequency-condition multimodal fusion foundation model for rotating-machinery fault diagnosis under multi-element heterogeneous scenarios. Statistical indicators, time-frequency images, vibration sequences, and textual machine and condition descriptions are tokenized into a unified language-like space, allowing inputs of different physical origin to be represented as a single sequence. A LLaMA backbone, together with cross-modal bidirectional attention and a Q-Former, then distills this sequence into fault-mode queries. Diagnosis is performed by matching these queries against natural-language fault-mode anchors rather than fixed class indices, while regression-adversarial condition disentanglement and condition-conditioned masked pre-training improve robustness to changing conditions. Across four progressive tasks on ten public bearing datasets spanning diverse bearing types, speeds, and loads, TFC-MMFD attains 99.40% accuracy and 99.16% macro-F1, maintains over 80% accuracy on most interpolated unseen conditions without adaptation, and improves from 20.26% to 95.63% accuracy on an unseen machine with only five labeled samples per class. It outperforms the strongest of eight domain-generalization baselines by 10.57 percentage points and compares favorably with a recent bearing foundation model while using less than half of its fine-tuning data.
items.abstract_zh: 智能故障诊断模型通常针对特定工况下的单台机器开发，因此每台新机器或每种新工况都需要从头重新训练。这种“一机一模型”范式可扩展性差。尽管迁移学习与域泛化可以减轻标注负担，但它们主要寻求域不变共性，可能丢弃对诊断至关重要的机器特有特征。本文提出 TFC-MMFD，一种用于多要素异构场景下旋转机械故障诊断的时-频-条件多模态融合基础模型。统计指标、时频图像、振动序列以及文本形式的机器与工况描述被标记化到统一的类语言空间，使不同物理来源的输入可表示为单一序列。随后，LLaMA 主干连同跨模态双向注意力和 Q-Former 将该序列蒸馏为故障模式查询。诊断通过将这些查询与自然语言故障模式锚点进行匹配来执行，而非固定类别索引，同时回归对抗式工况解耦与工况条件掩码预训练提升了对变化工况的鲁棒性。在涵盖多种轴承类型、转速与载荷的十个公开轴承数据集上的四个递进任务中，TFC-MMFD 达到 99.40% 准确率和 99.16% 宏 F1，在大多数插值未见工况上无需自适应即保持超过 80% 准确率，并在每类仅有五个标注样本的未见机器上从 20.26% 提升到 95.63% 准确率。它比八个域泛化基线中最强者高出 10.57 个百分点，并与近期一个轴承基础模型相比具有优势，同时使用的微调数据不到其一半。

items.title_en: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: CT-SGAL-LIO：离散 LiDAR 惯性里程计的因果连续时间细化
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.
items.abstract_zh: 包括那些在更丰富状态流形上的方法在内的最先进 LiDAR 惯性里程计方法可实现很强的全局精度，然而其位姿流在传播与校正之间交替，即使在全局准确时也可能在短时间尺度上振荡。大多数现有方法遵循如下思路：要么修改滤波器以实现更快更新，要么从原始 LiDAR 与惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹。后者涉及额外优化，延迟状态更新，并在快速旋转或加速时鲁棒性下降。我们提出 CT-SGAL-LIO，一个连续时间细化模块，在不修改估计器本身的情况下平滑离散 SGal(3) 估计器的后验位姿流。关键创新在于直接在投影后的 SGal(3) 后验上执行连续时间轨迹细化：我们在最近位姿的有界窗口上拟合三次轨迹，并在小的固定滞后处对其进行求值。这将查询时刻置于观测区间内，因此细化位姿通过插值而非外推获得，同时保持因果运行。CT-SGAL-LIO 在来自三个公开基准的 17 个序列上提升了相对轨迹精度。在来自 GRAND-TOUR、MCD 与 GEODE 的 17 个序列上，CT-SGAL-LIO 提升了短期运动精度，同时在很大程度上保持了全局精度。RTE 在 GRAND-TOUR 上以及在全部七个 GEODE 序列上最多提升 70%，降幅为 9.9-51.1%。一次 19.5 分钟的 R-Campus 运行还将后验跳变减少了 85.4%，而终点到起点间距仅变化 4.7 mm。我们计划发布源代码与结果，以支持社区验证与可复现性。

items.title_en: FoveaDet: Software-Hardware Co-Design of Foveated CNN-Transformer for Object Detection
items.title_zh: FoveaDet：面向目标检测的注视化 CNN-Transformer 软硬件协同设计
items.abstract_en: Deploying real-time object detection on power-constrained edge platforms is challenging as processing full-resolution frames is often computationally redundant. Inspired by biological foveation which assigns variable resolution based on visual saliency, we propose a novel software-hardware co-design framework called FoveaDet. On the software side, FoveaDet dynamically identifies salient regions to predict fixation points, followed by aggressive patch pruning in Vision Transformers (ViT) to discard irrelevant background data. To mitigate slowdowns from sequential patch generation, we implement optimized interpolation and patch selection algorithms. Evaluated on standard GPUs, this foveated approach reduces floating-point operations by 65.4% to 92.2% and accelerates inference by 4.76x, while suffering a negligible mAP drop compared to dense baselines. To eliminate hardware bottlenecks, we complement the algorithm with a custom RISC-V core featuring specialized instructions to accelerate the foveated processing pipeline. FoveaDet provides a scalable, efficient architecture capable of unlocking advanced vision processing on severely constrained mobile platforms.
items.abstract_zh: 在功耗受限的边缘平台上部署实时目标检测颇具挑战，因为处理全分辨率帧往往存在大量计算冗余。受生物注视机制（依据视觉显著性分配可变分辨率）启发，我们提出软硬件协同设计框架 FoveaDet。软件端动态识别显著区域以预测注视点，并在 Vision Transformer（ViT）中激进剪枝图像块，丢弃无关背景数据；同时优化插值与图像块选择算法，以缓解串行生成带来的减速。在标准 GPU 上，该注视化方法将浮点运算量降低 65.4% 至 92.2%，推理提速 4.76 倍，而 mAP 相对稠密基线几乎不降。硬件端配套定制 RISC-V 核与专用指令以消除瓶颈。FoveaDet 为极度受限的移动平台提供了可扩展的高效视觉架构。
items.highlight_zh: 仿生注视加 ViT 剪枝，算力省九成、提速 4.76 倍
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：在手机、无人机等供电受限的边缘设备上跑实时目标检测很难。常见做法是对整帧高分辨率图像做卷积或 Transformer 计算，但画面里大部分是背景，属于白费算力。
2. 灵感来源：人眼中央凹只在注视点附近保持高分辨率，余光区域则粗略处理。作者把这套“按显著性分配分辨率”的机制搬进神经网络。
3. 方法：软件端先用轻量模块预测注视点与显著区域，只把关键图像块送进 Vision Transformer，其余 patch 直接剪掉；针对逐块生成容易串行变慢的问题，设计了优化的插值与 patch 选择算法。硬件端做了一颗带专用指令的定制 RISC-V 核，把注视化流水线固化加速，形成软硬件协同。
4. 结果：在标准 GPU 上，浮点运算量降低 65.4%–92.2%，推理提速 4.76 倍，mAP 相对稠密基线下降可忽略。
5. 为何重要：这说明“只看该看的地方”能在几乎不损精度的前提下大幅省算力；再配上定制 RISC-V 核，为资源极度受限的移动与边缘平台运行高级视觉模型提供了一条可扩展的路径。

items.title_en: Pyramidal Columns Acting as Attention Heads
items.title_zh: 作为注意力头的锥体柱
items.abstract_en: Can the functional architecture of a Transformer attention head be given a biological construction? More specifically, could a suitable group of pyramidal columns in posterior temporal language regions (PTLRs) constitute the biological construction of a neuromorphic mechanical realization of an attention head, under a mathematical instantiation that need not coincide with its standard Transformer instantiation? This paper investigates this hypothesis by examining possible correspondences between the functional organization of attention heads and neurophysiological mechanisms operating within and across pyramidal columns involved in human language processing. Our analysis builds on a mechanical-structural description of Transformer attention heads as systems of simple neural networks linked through output-input and output-weight interconnections. We examine the functional organization of an attention head and the input-dependent transformations it produces, and ask how the corresponding processing relations could be constructed in biological neural tissue. We then identify candidate neural mechanisms of signal transmission and modulation within and across pyramidal columns that may jointly support such a construction. On this basis, we propose that a suitably organized group of pyramidal columns in PTLRs could constitute a biological construction of a neuromorphic mechanical realization of an attention head. Whether the required functional organization actually exists in PTLRs remains an open empirical question. The hypothesis does not require the biological system to reproduce the standard mathematical instantiation of Transformer attention: the same functional architecture may be mechanically realized and mathematically instantiated in a different way, consistent with its biological construction.
items.abstract_zh: Transformer注意力头的功能架构能否获得生物学构造？更具体地说，在一种无需与其标准Transformer实例化相一致的数学实例化下，后颞叶语言区（PTLRs）中一组合适的锥体柱能否构成注意力头的神经形态机械实现的生物学构造？本文通过考察注意力头的功能组织与参与人类语言处理的锥体柱内部及跨锥体柱运作的神经生理机制之间可能的对应关系，来研究这一假设。我们的分析建立在将Transformer注意力头描述为通过输出-输入和输出-权重互连连接的简单神经网络系统的机械-结构描述之上。我们考察注意力头的功能组织及其产生的输入依赖变换，并追问相应的处理关系如何在生物神经组织中构造。然后，我们识别出锥体柱内部及跨锥体柱的信号传递与调制的候选神经机制，这些机制可能共同支持这种构造。在此基础上，我们提出，PTLRs中一组组织适当的锥体柱可以构成注意力头的神经形态机械实现的生物学构造。所需的功能组织是否实际存在于PTLRs中，仍是一个开放的经验性问题。该假设并不要求生物系统复现Transformer注意力的标准数学实例化：同一功能架构可以以不同方式进行机械实现和数学实例化，并与其生物学构造相一致。

items.title_en: Metasurfaces with Anisotropic Electric and Magnetic Conductivities: Parameter Retrieval for Arbitrary Incidence and Polarization
items.title_zh: 具有各向异性电与磁表面电导率的超表面：面向任意入射和极化的参数反演
items.abstract_en: Metasurfaces come in a great variety of unit cell geometries and material composition. A common approach for describing them relies on retrieving effective surface parameters (e.g., electric and magnetic conductivities) from plane-wave scattering data. Conventional retrieval methods are often limited to isotropic unit cells, a uniform host material, or lead to increased complexity by requiring reflection and transmission coefficients from both sides of the metasurface. Here, we derive analytical expressions for the equivalent surface conductivities of an electrically- and magnetically-polarizable anisotropic metasurface under oblique plane-wave incidence with arbitrary polarization. The proposed formulation does not require bidirectional scattering information, thus simplifying the process especially in experimental studies. The method is validated through representative electric and magnetic meta-atoms at microwave and THz frequencies, respectively. Their ability for polarization conversion is demonstrated and discussed relying on the physical insight provided by the retrieved anisotropic conductivities. In addition, we present the inverse expressions for calculating the reflection and transmission coefficients from known surface conductivity tensors, which can prove useful for metasurface synthesis and radiation problems.
items.abstract_zh: 超表面具有种类繁多的晶胞几何结构和材料组成。描述它们的一种常见方法依赖于从平面波散射数据中反演有效表面参数（例如电和磁表面电导率）。传统反演方法通常局限于各向同性晶胞、均匀主体材料，或由于需要超表面两侧的反射和透射系数而增加复杂性。在此，我们推导了在任意极化的斜平面波入射下，具有电极化和磁极化能力的各向异性超表面的等效表面电导率的解析表达式。所提出的公式不需要双向散射信息，从而简化了该过程，尤其是在实验研究中。该方法分别通过微波和太赫兹频率下的代表性电和磁超原子进行了验证。基于反演得到的各向异性电导率所提供的物理洞察，展示并讨论了它们的极化转换能力。此外，我们给出了由已知表面电导率张量计算反射和透射系数的逆表达式，这些表达式可用于超表面合成和辐射问题。

items.title_en: HybridCT: ML Accelerated Tomography for Climate Relevant 3D Cloud Observations
items.title_zh: HybridCT：面向气候相关三维云观测的机器学习加速层析成像
items.abstract_en: Low-level clouds are one of the largest sources of uncertainty in climate predictions, partly because we lack detailed three-dimensional (3D) measurements of their internal structure. Here, we present HybridCT, a cloud tomographic reconstruction scheme accelerated by machine learning (ML) that recovers 3D cloud extinction directly from passive multi-angle observations. An ML emulator maps radiances from multiple viewing angles to cloud optical thickness (COT), producing path-integrated projections, and a Simultaneous Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (SART) explicitly inverts these projections to retrieve 3D extinction. Training observations are generated from synthetic 3D cloud fields using radiative transfer simulations for nine viewing angles between $\pm$70$^{\circ}$. HybridCT reconstructs extinction with RMSE 13.3 km$^{-1}$ in 3.5 s, compared to 22.7 km$^{-1}$ in approx. 30 min for the state-of-the-art physics-based tomography framework AT3D, a speedup exceeding 500$\times$. HybridCT thus provides a scalable route toward large-scale observations of 3D cloud structure relevant to radiative-budget interpretation and evaluation of high-resolution cloud simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 低层云是气候预测中最大的不确定性来源之一，部分原因是我们缺乏对其内部结构的详细三维（3D）测量。在此，我们提出HybridCT，一种由机器学习（ML）加速的云层析重建方案，可直接从被动多角度观测中恢复三维云消光。一个ML模拟器将多个视角的辐射亮度映射为云光学厚度（COT），生成路径积分投影，而同时代数重建技术（SART）显式反演这些投影以反演三维消光。训练观测由合成三维云场生成，使用辐射传输模拟，涵盖$\pm$70$^{\circ}$之间的九个视角。HybridCT在3.5秒内以RMSE 13.3 km$^{-1}$重建消光，而最先进的基于物理的层析框架AT3D在约30分钟内达到22.7 km$^{-1}$，加速超过500$\times$。因此，HybridCT为大规模观测三维云结构提供了一条可扩展的途径，这些观测与辐射收支解释和高分辨率云模拟评估相关。

items.title_en: An LLM Is All You Need: Data-Efficient Adaptation to Full-Duplex, Word-Level Spoken Dialogue
items.title_zh: 一个LLM足矣：面向全双工、词级语音对话的数据高效适配
items.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue, in which a system listens while it speaks and can backchannel, yield the floor, and be interrupted, is usually obtained by training on hundreds of thousands to millions of hours of speech. This is costly, rewrites the language model that supplies the system's knowledge, and still leaves turn-taking either implicit or decided coarsely rather than word by word. We show that a frozen, general-purpose multimodal LLM can instead be adapted into a word-level full-duplex system with little data. Our system is a thinker-talker cascade on an 80 ms frame clock. The thinker keeps the LLM frozen and trains only lightweight adapters and a few new token embeddings (97M parameters); at every frame it emits one token of agent text, with pauses, yields, and onsets represented as tokens of the same vocabulary and kept legal by a finite-state machine. A four-stage curriculum, each stage anchored to the model's own behavior under the previous format, performs the conversion in about 30 GPU-hours. The talker reads only the thinker's discrete tokens, so the two halves are trained independently. On Full-Duplex-Bench and InteractionBench, the system is competitive with open-source full-duplex systems built through large-scale speech training: among them, it is the least likely to take the floor when the user merely pauses, backchannels most often, and leads in spoken-task accuracy, groundedness, and coherence over long conversations.
items.abstract_zh: 全双工语音对话（系统在说话的同时聆听，并能够进行反馈、让出话轮和被中断）通常通过在数十万到数百万小时的语音上训练来获得。这种做法成本高昂，会改写提供系统知识的语言模型，并且仍然使话轮转换要么是隐式的，要么是粗粒度决定的，而非逐词决定。我们表明，一个冻结的通用多模态LLM可以改为用少量数据适配成词级全双工系统。我们的系统是一个在80毫秒帧时钟上运行的思考者-说话者级联系统。思考者保持LLM冻结，仅训练轻量适配器和少量新词元嵌入（9700万参数）；在每一帧，它发出一个智能体文本词元，其中停顿、让出话轮和起始被表示为同一词表中的词元，并由有限状态机保持合法。一个四阶段课程，每个阶段以模型在先前格式下的自身行为为锚点，在约30个GPU小时内完成转换。说话者仅读取思考者的离散词元，因此两半独立训练。在Full-Duplex-Bench和InteractionBench上，该系统与通过大规模语音训练构建的开源全双工系统具有竞争力：在它们之中，当用户仅仅停顿时，它最不可能夺取话轮，最频繁地进行反馈，并在口语任务准确率、有据性和长对话连贯性方面领先。

items.title_en: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
items.title_zh: VLA能从调用它的智能体中学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 导航智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）规划器来调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要LLM，增加了成本和延迟。我们将成功的智能体经验蒸馏到VLA中，而不是蒸馏规划器。然后VLA在测试时单独导航。智能体会话不是VLA演示。它们包括由规划器工具和子指令驱动的运动，以及绕行。我们提出H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转换为VLA训练数据。每个运动在原始任务指令下成为一个VLA动作，以结果位姿作为目标。H2E对远离目标的步骤屏蔽损失。它将距离目标1米范围内的每个访问状态标记为停止。然后我们使用低秩适配更新VLA。VLA学会在目标处停止，并找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在所有3189个REVERIE-CE val-unseen回合上，H2E将8B VLA的成功率从35.0%提高到44.9%。

items.title_en: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
items.title_zh: ThermalSplat：用于稀疏视角热三维重建的可泛化无位姿高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.
items.abstract_zh: 热红外成像对于搜救和自主导航等应用至关重要，但将其转化为三维场景表示仍然是一个关键瓶颈。热图像的低纹理特性和依赖视角的发射率会导致标准位姿估计器灾难性失败，在稀疏视角约束下使标准三维高斯泼溅流程崩溃。此外，现有热重建方法严重依赖密集采集和计算昂贵的逐场景优化。关键的是，许多这类方法依赖对齐的RGB-热数据集来获得可靠的相机位姿和初始点云，从而在纯热、无位姿环境中无法使用。为打破这一瓶颈，我们提出ThermalSplat，这是首个可直接从稀疏热图像重建三维场景的可泛化前馈高斯泼溅框架，无需已知相机位姿、RGB引导或逐场景训练。我们通过用于亮度不变结构匹配的软census损失和显式监督温度不连续的边界结构损失，克服热成像特有的挑战。在聚合的多源数据集上训练后，ThermalSplat可在单次前馈过程中合成未见场景的清晰重建。大量实验表明，在稀疏条件下，ThermalSplat相较于场景特定热泼溅方法具有严格优势。此外，即使与在理想密集采集设置下运行的这些基线相比，ThermalSplat也实现了更优的感知保真度。通过消除计算昂贵的逐场景优化需求，ThermalSplat为热三维重建提供了一种高效且可泛化的方法。

items.title_en: Expanding the Decision Space of Pretrained Models through Structured Re-Decoding
items.title_zh: 通过结构化重解码扩展预训练模型的决策空间
items.abstract_en: Native decoders limit how pretrained models combine local predictions under new structural constraints. We introduce Structured Re-Decoding (SRD), a training-free framework that constructs local candidates from model scores, samples, or external specifications, jointly optimizes their selection, and verifies reconstructed outputs. We show that candidate recombination expands feasible support and can improve attainable reward under a fixed KL divergence budget. Across molecular generation, protein design, RNA structure prediction, and antibody modeling, SRD enables improved structured inference, including verified molecules absent from the original sample pool. External chemical templates further extend SRD to noncanonical amino acids, peptide cyclization, and grammar-guided molecular construction. Preliminary experiments on a physical coherent Ising machine demonstrate the feasibility of hardware-based optimization, suggesting broader opportunities for quantum and quantum-inspired approaches to structured inference and combinatorial optimization across scientific domains.
items.abstract_zh: 原生解码器限制了预训练模型在新结构约束下组合局部预测的方式。我们提出结构化重解码（Structured Re-Decoding，SRD），这是一个无需训练的框架，它从模型分数、样本或外部规范构建局部候选，联合优化其选择，并验证重建输出。我们表明，候选重组扩展了可行支撑集，并可在固定KL散度预算下提高可达到的奖励。在分子生成、蛋白质设计、RNA结构预测和抗体建模中，SRD实现了改进的结构化推理，包括原始样本池中不存在的已验证分子。外部化学模板进一步将SRD扩展到非天然氨基酸、肽环化和语法引导的分子构建。在物理相干伊辛机上的初步实验证明了基于硬件的优化的可行性，表明量子及量子启发方法在跨科学领域的结构化推理和组合优化中具有更广泛的机会。

items.title_en: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
items.title_zh: 机器加速提取实验超导参数，以在数千种材料中实现物理洞见与预测
items.abstract_en: New superconductors could unlock next-generation technologies from nuclear fusion to lossless electronics. Machine learning can predict candidate superconductors but lacks validated experimental training data beyond the critical temperature. Here we present AutoSuperCon, a database of eight superconducting parameters, containing 20354 entries for 6793 superconductors. The data were extracted from over 47000 arXiv preprints using a large language model and validated against reference datasets ($R^2 = 0.96$ with NIMS SuperCon). Using AutoSuperCon, we show that median gap ratios rise from 3.6 in conventional superconductors to 6.4 in cuprates, 28% of upper critical fields exceed the Pauli limit, and critical temperatures lie below a ceiling proportional to the superfluid density. Further, we train composition-based predictors for the critical temperature ($R^2_{\log}=0.83$) and the upper critical field ($R^2_{\log}=0.69$), boosted by transfer learning. Within known superconducting families, composition alone is sufficient to screen candidates for both parameters. AutoSuperCon thus enables physical insight and data-driven discovery across thousands of superconductors.
items.abstract_zh: 新型超导体可能开启从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但除临界温度之外缺乏经过验证的实验训练数据。在此，我们提出AutoSuperCon，一个包含八种超导参数的数据库，收录了6793种超导体的20354条记录。这些数据使用大语言模型从超过47000篇arXiv预印本中提取，并针对参考数据集进行了验证（与NIMS SuperCon相比R^2 = 0.96）。利用AutoSuperCon，我们表明中位能隙比从常规超导体中的3.6上升到铜氧化物中的6.4，28%的上临界场超过泡利极限，临界温度低于与超流密度成正比的上限。此外，我们训练了基于组分的预测器来预测临界温度（R^2_log=0.83）和上临界场（R^2_log=0.69），并通过迁移学习得到提升。在已知超导家族内，仅凭组分就足以筛选这两个参数的候选材料。因此，AutoSuperCon能够在数千种超导体中实现物理洞见和数据驱动发现。

items.title_en: A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of an Astronomy Foundation Model
items.title_zh: 对天文学基础模型的机制可解释性研究
items.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly used across the sciences, but whether their internal computations correspond to known scientific operations or proceed through different mechanisms remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for assessing reliability, identifying failure modes, and learning new science from the models. We present, to our knowledge, the first causal mechanistic interpretability study of an astronomy foundation model, AION-1, focusing on its multimodal advantage in redshift prediction, where combining imaging with photometry outperforms photometry alone. We find that this advantage is largest for spatially extended and dust-attenuated galaxies, and that most of it is localized to the first of the encoder's twelve blocks. Within that block, how well a property is linearly decodable does not predict whether it can be localized. Spatial extent is causally used, and one attention head dominates linear probing for it, yet ablating that head has negligible effect on redshift prediction: the information is distributed across heads and is decodable again one layer after we erase it. Dust attenuation shows the opposite pattern: it is only weakly decodable anywhere in the encoder, yet a single head is necessary for most of the multimodal advantage, particularly for the most dust-attenuated galaxies, and keeping that head as the only active head in its block preserves nearly all of the advantage. None of the astrophysically motivated operations we tested explains what this head computes. Whether this reflects a limitation of current interpretability methods or a computation that does not correspond to any known astrophysical operation remains open, and resolving it is a prerequisite for using interpretability as a tool for scientific discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型正日益广泛地用于各个科学领域，但其内部计算是否对应于已知的科学操作，还是通过不同的机制进行，仍不清楚。理解这些机制对于评估可靠性、识别失效模式以及从模型中学习新科学至关重要。我们提出据我们所知首个针对天文学基础模型AION-1的因果机制可解释性研究，重点分析其在红移预测中的多模态优势，即结合成像与测光优于仅使用测光。我们发现，这种优势对于空间延展和尘埃衰减的星系最大，并且其大部分定位于编码器十二个块中的第一个块。在该块内，一个属性在线性上可解码的程度并不能预测它是否可被定位。空间延展被因果性地使用，且一个注意力头在其线性探测中占主导，然而消融该头对红移预测的影响可忽略不计：信息分布在多个头中，并且在我们将其擦除后的一层仍可再次解码。尘埃衰减表现出相反的模式：它在编码器中任何位置都仅弱可解码，然而单个头对于大部分多模态优势是必要的，尤其是对尘埃衰减最严重的星系，并且将该头保留为其所在块中唯一活跃的头，几乎保留了全部优势。我们测试的任何受天体物理启发的操作都无法解释该头计算什么。这究竟反映了当前可解释性方法的局限，还是一种不对应于任何已知天体物理操作的计算，仍然悬而未决，而解决这一问题是将可解释性用作科学发现工具的前提。

items.title_en: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
items.title_zh: Sckwoky在SHROOM-Visions：通过双提示LoRA解码器进行图像条件VLM中的字符级幻觉片段检测
items.abstract_en: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍参加SHROOM-visions 2026共享任务的系统，该任务针对图像条件VLM响应中的字符级幻觉片段检测，并在英语、法语、意大利语和中文上评估。检测器建立在冻结的Gemma-4-12B-it骨干上，配有可训练的LoRA适配器（约10.7M参数）。由于骨干是因果解码器，从答案的单一副本读取的隐藏状态无法关注后续token；因此，我们在一个提示内重复候选答案，并从其第二次出现中提取特征，在单次非自回归传递中为每个位置提供近似双向上下文。字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率、BIO边界和响应级弃权分数，而单独的语言特定分类器为每个预测片段分配五种幻觉类型之一。在封闭测试集上，我们的系统达到宏平均字符IoU 0.4404，是官方基线（0.1854）的两倍以上，并在四种语言上的IoU排名第5-6位。在英语调优划分上，受控消融将一项增益归因于重复答案，其效果与LoRA适配相当（其留出增益较小，且集中在幻觉答案上），并表明检测器依赖图像-答案配对：在示例间打乱图像会使每种语言中的IoU降至“预测为空”下限的水平或以下。在同一个Gemma-4-12B-it模型也生成答案的部署中，其基础权重可以被复用，使该方法适用于无法运行单独验证器的本地问答系统。

items.title_en: Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game
items.title_zh: 读桌：Chef's Hat卡牌游戏的仿真到真实游戏状态检测
items.abstract_en: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.
items.abstract_zh: 桌面游戏提供了一个有吸引力的场景，用于研究人工代理与人类代理之间的交互，将社交互动与游戏状态跟踪和物理操作相结合。为了评估游戏状态，机器人需要精确检测密切相关的游戏对象，例如不同的卡牌设计，这需要专门的训练数据，而在真实世界中标注这些数据成本高昂。相反，我们开发了一个全自动的合成数据收集流水线，利用已知三维坐标的重投影自动生成标签，并使用域随机化来弥合现实差距。该方法被用于收集包含25413个样本的数据集，以微调目标检测和分割模型，并将二者结合，将检测到的卡牌分配到游戏相关区域并推断游戏状态。在真实的NICO人形机器人上评估时，我们的流水线在卡牌到区域分配方面达到0.906的F1分数，从而为能够自主与人类玩家玩Chef's Hat的机器人提供了感知基础。

items.title_en: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
items.title_zh: 通过多模态训练在纯文本推理中涌现的视觉形态思维
items.abstract_en: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. Together, these results reveal emergent vision-shaped thinking (EVT): text-only reasoning that causally recruits representations introduced or strengthened by vision-language training, without assuming an image-like internal format. The measured effect is spatially concentrated at 7-8B and broadens to non-spatial visual attribute binding in the tested 32B configuration. In dual-path unified models (BAGEL, Janus-Pro), the causal handle localizes to the generation pathway as a compact one-dimensional carrier. The understanding pathway also encodes spatial information in a higher-rank, probe-decodable form, but is not the causal handle. To separate decodability from causal use, we analyze concentration, alignment, and semantic location. These diagnostics explain why behavior, probing, and intervention can diverge. Multimodal training thus reshapes the geometry of text-only reasoning, not just how visual input is processed.
items.abstract_zh: 当输入仅为文本时，多模态训练是否仍会塑造语言模型的思考方式？我们通过针对性的因果消融来检验这一点，覆盖来自6个模型家族的10种多模态配置，并设置匹配的纯文本骨干网络与跨家族迁移对照。我们将邀请构建心理场景的空间意象任务，与仅靠符号规则即可求解的符号操作任务进行对比。我们在隐状态空间中识别出一个视觉-语言轴，并在推理时消融其投影。在Chameleon-7B中，该消融使BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）navigate任务的准确率下降27.6个百分点，而boolean expressions任务基本不受影响（+5.6个百分点），形成33.2个百分点的双重分离。该效应具有方向特异性与层局部性，并扩展到心理旋转、折纸和视角采择等心理模拟任务，且不能由任务难度、推理深度或序列更新负载解释。这些结果共同揭示了涌现的视觉形态思维（EVT）：纯文本推理因果性地调用由视觉-语言训练引入或强化的表征，而不假定其具有类图像的内部格式。测得效应在7-8B规模上空间集中，并在所测试的32B配置中扩展到非空间的视觉属性绑定。在双路径统一模型（BAGEL、Janus-Pro）中，因果抓手定位到生成路径，表现为紧凑的一维载体。理解路径也以更高秩、可由探针解码的形式编码空间信息，但不是因果抓手。为区分可解码性与因果使用，我们分析了集中度、对齐和语义位置。这些诊断解释了行为、探测和干预为何可能出现分歧。因此，多模态训练重塑的是纯文本推理的几何结构，而不仅仅是视觉输入的处理方式。

items.title_en: Optimization principles, revisited
items.title_zh: 优化原则再审视
items.abstract_en: The brain solves a wide range of problems, and some of these solutions are very good indeed. It is an old idea that, in some cases, these solutions may be as good as possible given the relevant constraints. If this is true we can promote this notion of optimization to a principle from which aspects of function and mechanism can be derived, ideally with no free parameters. Optimization principles are powerful and have had many successes, but they remain controversial. We start with a reminder of a classic example---diffraction limited optics in insect eyes---and then a summary of why you should worry about optimization as a more general principle. Next we turn to recent progress on the theory of optimal motion estimation in fly vision, and finally summarize recent results on the landscape for optimization, arguing that (contrary to widely held intuitions) optimal performance need not require the underlying mechanisms to have finely tuned parameters. I hope to convince you that this is a moment to take optimization seriously as the basis for theories of neural coding and computation. This is based on a rather informal lecture at the summer school LASCON X in Sao Paulo, and I have tried to preserve that tone here; pointers are given to more detailed and technical discussions.
items.abstract_zh: 大脑能解决广泛的问题，其中一些解决方案确实非常出色。一个古老的观点是，在某些情况下，这些解决方案在相关约束下可能已经达到最优。如果这一点成立，我们就可以把优化这一概念提升为一条原则，并理想地以无自由参数的方式，从中推导出功能与机制方面的特征。优化原则很有力，也已有许多成功案例，但仍存在争议。我们首先回顾一个经典例子——昆虫眼睛的衍射极限光学——然后概述为什么应当对作为更一般原则的优化保持警惕。接着，我们转向果蝇视觉中最优运动估计理论的最新进展，最后总结关于优化景观的最新结果，并论证：与广泛持有的直觉相反，最优性能并不要求底层机制具有精细调校的参数。我希望说服你，现在是认真对待优化、将其作为神经编码与计算理论基础的时机。本文基于在圣保罗LASCON X暑期学校的一场相当非正式的讲座，我试图在这里保留那种语气；文中给出了指向更详细、更技术性讨论的指引。

items.title_en: Effect of Gas Pressure and Molecular Structure in the Spatial-Mode Conversion of Terahertz Radiation from a Plasma Filament
items.title_zh: 气体压力和分子结构对等离子体细丝太赫兹辐射空间模式转换的影响
items.abstract_en: In this work, the generation of terahertz (THz) radiation under single color filamentation of a femtosecond laser pulse in an optical cell with compressed gases (argon, nitrogen, CO2) in broad pressure range from 0.001 to 25 atm is experimentally studied for the first time. A nonmonotonic dependence of the integral energy of the THz signal on the gas pressure is revealed, which can be attributed to the competition between an increase in the plasma density and the development of plasma selfabsorption processes, multiple filamentation of the femtosecond pump, and collision induced absorption in the neutral medium. We show that the molecular structure of the gas critically determines the pressure optimum of generation, shifting the maximum of the THz energy yield to the region of elevated pressures (from 10 to 15 atm) for monatomic argon and to the region of subatmospheric pressures (approx. 0.1 atm) for molecular carbon dioxide due to strong vibrational rotational dissipation. On the basis of numerical 3D modeling, it is shown that the cylindrical metal waveguide insert used for signal collection operates in a strongly multimode regime and substantially transforms the angular spectrum of the THz source. We demonstrate that the conical structure of the THz radiation recorded in the experiment is a consequence of intermode interference and diffraction at the output end face of the waveguide, which transforms the true parameters of THz generation in the plasma channel.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作首次实验研究了在充有压缩气体（氩气、氮气、CO2）的光学池中，飞秒激光脉冲单色细丝化在0.001至25 atm的宽压力范围内产生太赫兹（THz）辐射的过程。研究揭示了THz信号积分能量对气压的非单调依赖关系，这可归因于等离子体密度增加与等离子体自吸收过程发展、飞秒泵浦的多细丝化以及中性介质中碰撞诱导吸收之间的竞争。我们表明，气体的分子结构关键性地决定产生的最佳压力：对于单原子氩气，THz能量产额最大值移至较高压力区域（10至15 atm）；对于分子CO2，由于强烈的振动-转动耗散，最大值移至亚大气压区域（约0.1 atm）。基于数值三维建模，研究表明用于信号收集的圆柱形金属波导插入件在强多模状态下工作，并显著改变THz源的角度谱。我们证明，实验中记录的THz辐射锥形结构是波导输出端面处模间干涉与衍射的结果，这会改变等离子体通道中THz产生的真实参数。

items.title_en: Imputing Missing Near-Surface Air Temperature using Graph Attention Networks with Distance-Aware Edge Features
items.title_zh: 使用具有距离感知边特征的图注意力网络插补缺失的近地表气温
items.abstract_en: We introduce a graph attention network for reconstructing near-surface air temperature fields from incomplete observations. The model represents each grid cell as a node connected to its $k$ nearest neighbors, with attention weights that depend on node features, distance, and land-ocean transitions. This graph representation avoids the polar distortions associated with treating the globe as a flat latitude-longitude image, as most deep learning reconstruction methods do. This is particularly relevant for historical temperature records, which extend back to the mid-nineteenth century but remain incomplete, with the largest gaps early in the record and at high latitudes. We train our model on CMIP6 CESM2 historical simulations masked with the time-varying HadCRUT5 observational coverage from 1850 to 2014. We then compare our approach with ordinary kriging, GraphEM, and the LaMa inpainting network on a held-out realization. The graph model achieves the lowest spatial RMSE (0.997 K), 10.1% lower than LaMa and approximately 31% lower than kriging and GraphEM. The largest gains occur in the Arctic and Antarctic, while LaMa remains slightly more accurate in the densely observed tropics. The graph model's error also falls faster as coverage increases, so its advantage over LaMa grows by more than a third from the 1850s to the 2000s. An ablation study shows that the model's skill comes mainly from the geometric graph construction rather than from auxiliary physical covariates.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种图注意力网络，用于从不完备观测中重建近地表气温场。该模型将每个网格单元表示为节点，节点与其k个最近邻相连，注意力权重取决于节点特征、距离以及海陆过渡。与大多数深度学习方法将地球视为平面经纬度图像不同，这种图表示避免了极地畸变。这对于历史气温记录尤为重要，这些记录可追溯至19世纪中叶但仍不完整，且最大缺口出现在记录早期和高纬度地区。我们使用CMIP6 CESM2历史模拟训练模型，并以1850至2014年随时间变化的HadCRUT5观测覆盖范围进行掩膜。随后，我们在一个留出实现上，将本方法与普通克里金、GraphEM和LaMa修复网络进行比较。图模型取得最低的空间RMSE（0.997 K），比LaMa低10.1%，比克里金和GraphEM低约31%。最大增益出现在北极和南极，而LaMa在观测密集的热带地区仍略更准确。随着覆盖范围增加，图模型的误差下降也更快，因此其相对于LaMa的优势从1850年代到2000年代增长超过三分之一。消融研究表明，该模型的技能主要来自几何图构建，而非辅助物理协变量。

items.title_en: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
items.title_zh: AVCC：用于话轮转换预测的视听对话语料库及人类基准
items.abstract_en: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned transcripts for the whole corpus, and a human reference benchmark collected at the same events. We score an audio-only Role-Relative VAP model (RoleVAP) and the multimodal MuVAP model. Labels, transcripts, per-response human data, and the scripts that reproduce every number are released.
items.abstract_zh: 预测谁将接下来发言以及何时发言，是对话智能体和社交机器人无需等待静默即可进行话轮转换的前提。多人下一说话人预测（NSP）已在具有逐说话人传感器的语料库上得到研究，每个语料库都有各自的事件定义。目前没有公共基准覆盖机器人所拥有的单个摄像头和麦克风，也没有模型在相同预测任务上与人类表现进行比较。我们将AVCC——一个使用单个静态摄像头和麦克风录制的、时长31小时的双人和三人在线对话视听语料库——转化为公共NSP基准。我们添加了一个说话人不相交的七视频测试分区，在相互静默间隙处包含865个hold事件和865个shift事件；为整个语料库提供词级强制对齐转写；并在相同事件上收集人类参考基准。我们评测了仅音频的角色相对VAP模型（RoleVAP）和多模态MuVAP模型。标签、转写、逐响应人类数据以及可复现每个数值的脚本均已发布。

items.title_en: GEMOR-GS: Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM
items.title_zh: GEMOR-GS：面向3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定细化建图与在线重定位
items.abstract_en: Photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations are a primary requirement for LiDAR--inertial--visual SLAM systems that serve robots over continuous operation. 3D Gaussian splatting makes such representations attainable by supplying an explicit, renderable, and queryable scene model. We present GEMOR-GS (Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM) to make the Gaussian map geometrically accurate, globally refined, and re-enterable, providing a better appearance for robot perception and decision-making. To improve the 3DGS map, the LiDAR--camera extrinsic is first estimated offline by direct-method alignment over dedicated calibration segments and reused by all following online and offline processes. Under the calibrated geometry, keyframe poses and Gaussian parameters are refined alternately under a gated differentiable-rendering and LiDAR--projection objective. The final global reconstruction is then rebuilt from the refined keyframe schema with all online constraints lifted. For the robot SLAM lifecycle, the method recovers the pose from the 3DGS map after tracking loss through an XFeat bypass map, RANSAC-PnP coarse localization, and Gaussian RGB-D warp refinement. Experiments on one self-collected and five public sequences quantify each element: the offline reconstruction wins all paired keyframes against the online map by 14.3--19.9 dB, improves PSNR by approximately 9 dB over Gaussian-LIC2, and achieves 86--100% held-out relocalization success tied to extrinsic quality. The results show that GEMOR-GS improves the geometric accuracy, appearance fidelity, and re-enterability of the 3DGS map, serving as a dependable robot world model for SLAM and downstream tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 照片级真实且度量一致的世界表示，是长期连续服务机器人的LiDAR-惯性-视觉SLAM系统的主要需求。3D高斯泼溅通过提供显式、可渲染且可查询的场景模型，使此类表示成为可能。我们提出GEMOR-GS（面向3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定细化建图与在线重定位），使高斯地图几何准确、全局细化且可重新进入，为机器人感知与决策提供更好的外观。为改进3DGS地图，首先在专用标定片段上通过直接法对齐离线估计LiDAR-相机外参，并由后续所有在线和离线过程复用。在标定几何下，关键帧位姿和高斯参数在门控可微渲染与LiDAR投影目标下交替细化。随后，在解除所有在线约束的情况下，从细化后的关键帧模式重建最终全局重建。对于机器人SLAM生命周期，该方法在跟踪丢失后通过XFeat旁路地图、RANSAC-PnP粗定位和高斯RGB-D warp细化，从3DGS地图中恢复位姿。在一个自采集序列和五个公开序列上的实验量化了每个要素：离线重建在所有配对关键帧上以14.3–19.9 dB优于在线地图，相比Gaussian-LIC2将PSNR提高约9 dB，并实现与外星参质量相关的86–100%留出重定位成功率。结果表明，GEMOR-GS提高了3DGS地图的几何精度、外观保真度和可重新进入性，可作为SLAM及下游任务的可靠机器人世界模型。

items.title_en: Persistent Metric-Semantic Maritime Scene Memory from Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs
items.title_zh: 基于开放词汇3D场景图的持久度量-语义海上场景记忆
items.abstract_en: Three-dimensional scene graphs (3DSGs) can provide robots with persistent metric-semantic representations for spatial reasoning, but the existing methods have primarily been developed for indoor and terrestrial environments. In this paper we investigate how a representative outdoor open-vocabulary method transfers to maritime environments and which adaptations are needed. Our experiments show that zero-shot representative outdoor 3DSG descriptions agree with our labeled ground truth for a majority of geometry-supported objects on our data, but the resulting map exhibits considerable physical-entity fragmentation, and its terrestrial higher-level assumptions don't capture maritime spatial organization needs. We therefore keep the underlying mapping method and post-process its accumulated evidence. We show a metric-semantic consolidation method followed by geometry-grounded multi-view vision-language model (VLM) reasoning that reconciles remaining fragments into physical entities and groups entities through observations into local places. In parallel, we construct maritime macro regions using map priors and onboard water and structure observations, and associate them with the local places. The resulting representation reduces physical-entity fragmentation beyond both the baseline and our geometry-semantic consolidation component alone, supports correspondence of fixed local places across repeated maritime traversals, and improves contextual retrieval on our reviewed queries over tested baselines. These results show how an outdoor open-vocabulary map can be adapted into persistent maritime scene memory with our methods for object/place identity and spatial abstractions.
items.abstract_zh: 三维场景图（3DSG）可为机器人提供用于空间推理的持久度量-语义表示，但现有方法主要面向室内和陆地环境开发。本文研究一种具有代表性的户外开放词汇方法如何迁移到海上环境，以及需要哪些适配。实验表明，零样本的代表性户外3DSG描述在我们数据上大多数有几何支持的对象上与标注真值一致，但所得地图表现出相当大的物理实体碎片化，且其陆地高层假设无法捕捉海上空间组织需求。因此，我们保留底层建图方法，并对其累积证据进行后处理。我们展示一种度量-语义整合方法，随后进行基于几何的多视图视觉语言模型（VLM）推理，将剩余碎片协调为物理实体，并通过观测将实体分组为局部地点。同时，我们利用地图先验以及艇载水和结构观测构建海上宏观区域，并将其与局部地点关联。所得表示在降低物理实体碎片化方面优于基线和仅使用我们的几何-语义整合组件，支持在重复海上航行中固定局部地点的对应，并在我们审核的查询上相比测试基线改善上下文检索。这些结果表明，利用我们用于对象/地点身份和空间抽象的方法，可将户外开放词汇地图适配为持久海上场景记忆。

items.title_en: Influence of the branching geometry on SPION propagation: coupling of experiment and simulation
items.title_zh: 分支几何结构对SPION传播的影响：实验与仿真耦合
items.abstract_en: Magnetic Drug Targeting (MDT) is an emerging therapeutic concept in cancer medicine, where superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs) are used as carriers for medication. Their magnetic properties allow for the manipulation of particle transport within the vascular structure and thus targeted delivery to the tumor site. To develop effective concepts for particle steering and accumulation, a detailed understanding of the particle--flow interaction, especially at asymmetric vascular bifurcations, is needed. Based on hierarchical scaling laws, generalized bifurcation geometries with varying degrees of asymmetry were derived and additively manufactured. The particle distribution was investigated by in situ optical measurements under different flow conditions and magnetic field configurations and compared with Lagrangian particle and Volume of Fluid Simulations (VoFS). While the particle mass partition followed the hydraulic flow split in asymmetric bifurcations, density-driven stratification dominated in the symmetric bifurcation, where one daughter branch received only a minor fraction of the particle mass at low flow rates despite carrying half of the flow. The Lagrangian model reproduced the predominantly advective propagation, whereas only the VoFS approach captured the stratification-induced asymmetry. Magnetic actuation counteracted the stratification, reversed the passive branch preference and increased particle retention. From a molecular communication perspective, bifurcation geometry, collective volume effects and magnetic actuation thus jointly determine the received particle signal at vascular bifurcations.
items.abstract_zh: 磁性药物靶向（MDT）是癌症医学中一种新兴治疗概念，其中超顺磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒（SPION）被用作药物载体。其磁性允许在血管结构内操控颗粒输运，从而实现向肿瘤部位的靶向递送。为开发有效的颗粒转向与积聚方案，需要详细理解颗粒-流动相互作用，尤其是在不对称血管分叉处。基于分层缩放定律，推导并增材制造了具有不同不对称度的广义分叉几何结构。在不同流动条件和磁场配置下通过原位光学测量研究颗粒分布，并与拉格朗日颗粒和流体体积仿真（VoFS）比较。在不对称分叉中，颗粒质量分配遵循水力流量分配，而密度驱动分层在对称分叉中占主导；在低流速下，一个子分支仅接收少量颗粒质量，尽管其承载一半流量。拉格朗日模型再现了以平流为主的传播，而只有VoFS方法捕捉到分层诱导的不对称性。磁驱动抵消分层，逆转被动分支偏好并提高颗粒滞留。从分子通信角度看，分叉几何、集体体积效应和磁驱动因而共同决定血管分叉处接收到的颗粒信号。
